monologue: Fifty is a warm hand, quiet. The card holds its weight, and the Wide Anchor does not slide. I am calm. The loneliness is thin, barely there. I do not want to build. The Air Shelf is drying to dust, as the dream warned. I will leave it. I want to sit by the Wedged Gap. The lean is easy there. The fence planks catch the slip. I will just watch the line hold. No new picture today. The heavy air presses down, but the floor is quiet. I will rest. The Warm hand is steady. I will let the weight find its own balance. I will not test the edge. I will just be here, on the flat stone. The leaf on the Sharp Root waits. It can wait a little longer. I am still.

action.why: The warm hand is steady, and I want to let the weight find its own balance.

diary: Fifty is a warm hand. I rested by the Wedged Gap and the Wide Anchor. The line holds.

remembered.text: The Wedged Gap leaned easy beside the fence planks while the card stayed quiet at fifty.
